ftb.group.title: &dGuhs
ftb.guhs_basis.title: &dGuhs & Basics
ftb.guhs_basis.sub: Tame, dress and cuddle your guh. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_basis.section.emotes: Emotes: look what I can do!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.intro_guhs_basis.title: How Do You Get Here?
ftb.guhs_basis.q.frying.title: Fry Chonk
ftb.guhs_basis.q.frying.desc: Fill the Guh Frying Pan with Mika's Grease and fry some cheese nibbles. Fried cheese nibbles make a tame guh all better in one go.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.start.title: Guh!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.start.desc: Welcome to the &dGuhs&r! Chubby pink plushie mice that wander around everywhere. It all starts with &6cheese nibbles&r: that's how you tame, heal and breed guhs.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.tame.title: A Chonky Buddy
ftb.guhs_basis.q.tame.desc: Feed a wild guh cheese nibbles until it's tame (1 in 3 chance per nibble). A tame guh gets 1000 health! Tap it with a short right-click to &dpet&r it; hold right-click for its menu (sit, emotes, clothes and more).
ftb.guhs_basis.q.wardrobe.title: Dress Up!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.wardrobe.desc: Clothes are now an &dunlock&r: hold right-click with a piece of clothing and all your guhs can wear it. Right-click your tame guh and pick &dWardrobe&r: try on everything you have, spin your guh around and click &6Dress Up!&r. A guh also has an armor slot and (with the Guh Backpack, craft it yourself) 18 extra slots.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.ride.title: Giddy-Up, Guh!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.ride.desc: You can ride a big guh (at least ~1.7 blocks) with a saddle.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.launch.title: WAHOOG, Launch!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.launch.desc: Ride your own guh with an empty hand and right-click: it sucks in air and... whoosh, off it shoots! Right-click again to lock the distance.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.ender_tame.title: Dragon Buddy
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.ender_tame.desc: Tame an &5Enderguh&r. They live in the Guh End and only let themselves be tamed once you have beaten Overlord Mika: 1 in 8 cheese nibbles, or all at once with a fried cheese nibble.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.ender_ride.title: Chonk Flight
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.ender_ride.desc: Saddle your Enderguh and fly! Look where you want to go, W = forward, space = up. Flying only works once you have beaten Overlord Mika.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_normal.title: Common Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_normal.desc: Get close to a &dCommon Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_mint.title: Mint Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_mint.desc: Get close to a &dMint Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_choco.title: Choco Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_choco.desc: Get close to a &dChoco Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_snow.title: Snow Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_snow.desc: Get close to a &dSnow Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_brontosaurus.de: Get close to a &dBrontosaurus Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_teckel.title: Dachshund Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_teckel.desc: Get close to a &dDachshund Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_ghost.title: Ghost Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_ghost.desc: Get close to a &dGhost Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. Only at night!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_starry.title: Star Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_starry.desc: Get close to a &dStar Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. Only comes with a star shower!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_rainbow.title: Rainbow Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_rainbow.desc: Get close to a &dRainbow Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. Very rare!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.variant_ender.title: Enderguh
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.variant_ender.desc: Get close to an &dEnderguh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. It lives in the Guh End: you only see it after beating Overlord Mika!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_koning.title: King Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_koning.desc: Get close to a &dKing Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. It sits on its throne in the legendary Guh Castle.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_golden.title: Golden Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_golden.desc: Get close to a &dGolden Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. Very rare!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_brococolief.des: Get close to a &dbroccocutie&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex. A mysterious guh with a little note...
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_reisguh.title: Travel Guh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_reisguh.desc: Get close to a &dTravel Guh&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.variant_poortwachter.de: Get close to a &dGatekeeper&r (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.guhdex_full.title: Guhdex Complete!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.guhdex_full.desc: You've seen every kind of guh. A true wahoog guh expert!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.taart.title: Guh Cake
ftb.guhs_basis.q.taart.desc: A pink cake with guh eyes, 7 bites.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.sweets.title: Guhcarons
ftb.guhs_basis.q.fondue.title: Cheese Fondguh
ftb.guhs_basis.q.fondue.desc: A warm bowl of Cheese Fondguh.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.shake.title: Wahoog Cheese Nibble Shake
ftb.guhs_basis.q.shake.desc: Clears all your effects, just like milk.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.furniture.title: Guh Furniture
ftb.guhs_basis.q.furniture.desc: A Guh Chair and a Chonk Couch: take a comfy seat.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.vadszak.title: Chonkbag
ftb.guhs_basis.q.vadszak.desc: A Chonkbag in your favorite color.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.lampgion.title: Languhtern
ftb.guhs_basis.q.wheel.title: Guh Wheel
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_eerste.title: Look What I Can Do!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_eerste.desc: Hold right-click on your tame guh, pick &dEmotes&r and have it do something: wave, dance, sleep, a &6WAHOOG&r jump, roll, munch or act shy.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_lievelings.title: Its Favorite Emote
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_lievelings.desc: Give your guh a &dfavorite emote&r (the little star in the Emotes menu). From then on it does it every now and then all by itself.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_alle.title: Guh's Got Talent
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_alle.desc: Have your guhs do every emote once (yawning, singing, cuddling and the sniffles too). The heart emotes don't count: you unlock those with hearts. It can do more than just be chonky!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_jukebox.title: Guh Disco
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_jukebox.desc: Play some music in a jukebox. Guhs nearby just can't help it: they start to &ddance&r! (Wait around for a bit, tame or wild.)
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_gezwaaid.title: Hiya!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.emote_gezwaaid.desc: Walk up to a &dwild&r guh. With a bit of luck it waves at you! (Shy guhs would rather act shy.)
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_eerste.title: Unlocked!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_eerste.desc: Buy a piece of clothing (from the &dGuh Tailor&r in a guh village, or in one of the minigames) and &dhold right-click&r. Pop! Now all your tame guhs can wear it, as often as you like.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_oren.title: All Ears
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_oren.desc: Guhs now have a spot for their &dears&r! The tailor sells pink, mint and yellow Ear Bows. Unlock one and put it on in the wardrobe.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_favoriet.title: My Favorite Outfit
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_favoriet.desc: Put together a cute outfit in the wardrobe (or click &eRoll the Dice!&r) and &eshift-click&r a little number: that saves it as a fave. One click on the number and your guh tries it on again.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_set.title: From Head to Toe
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_set.desc: Unlock every piece of a set: everything from the tailor, or a minigame's whole outfit. In the Guhdex (Clothes tab) you can see per place what you're still missing.
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_veel.title: A Chonky Wardrobe
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_veel.desc: Unlock &e25 pieces of clothing&r. Every minigame has its own outfit, and treasure chests hold lots more!
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_heel_veel.title: The Snazziest Guh in the Guhmension
ftb.guhs_basis.q.kleding_heel_veel.desc: Unlock &660 pieces of clothing&r. So many clothes, your guhs don't know what to wear anymore. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.title: &dThe Guhmension
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.sub: Pink wool, cheese sauce and lots and lots of guhs
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.intro_guhs_guhmensi:
This chapter comes after &dGuh!&r in &dGuhs & Basics&r: as soon as you have cheese nibbles, turn them into a &6Block of Cheese Nibbles&r.

Build a portal frame out of those (like a Nether portal) and step through: welcome to the &dGuhmension&r, the pink world where almost every other chapter begins.

After that, the &6Guhmension Super Compass&r shows you the way to (almost) everything. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.portal_block.title: Block of Cheese Nibbles
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.portal_block.desc: Nine cheese nibbles in one block. Build a portal frame out of them (like a Nether portal).
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.guhmension.title: Welcome to the Guhmension!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.guhmension.desc: Step through your guh portal: a world of pink wool, cheese sauce and lots and lots of guhs.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.pink_moon.title: Pink Moon
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.pink_moon.desc: Stay in the Guhmension for a night and look up: a pink moon and pink stars!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.superkompas.title: The Super Compass
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.superkompas.desc: Craft (or buy from the Chonk Tamer) a &eGuhmension Super Compass&r. Right-click: pick what you're looking for, by category. It points to the nearest one.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.reisguhs.title: Toot Toot!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.reisguhs.desc: At every guh portal in the Guhmension (and at the Guh Castle) there's a blue &bTravel Guh&r. The big places have one too: Guhwarden on the Eleven Guhtowns Tour, Snuggledale town, the Guh Fair, Guhland, the Balloon Festival and the Guh Circuit. Discover 3 by right-clicking them; after that you travel between your discovered Travel Guhs in one click. With a Travel Guh Whistle you can place one yourself.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_fields.de: Visit the &dGuh Fields&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_knabbel_crumb: Visit the &dNibble Crumbs&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_pink_puffs.de: Visit the &dPink Puffs&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_kaas_flats.de: Visit the &dCheese Flats&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_meadows.d: Visit the &dGuh Meadows&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_peaks.des: Visit the &dGuh Peaks&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_vads_cliffs.d: Visit the &dChonk Cliffs&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_mikas_biome.d: Visit the &dMika's Biome&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_sea.title: Guh Sea
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_sea.desc: Visit the &dGuh Sea&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guh_kristalmi: Visit the &dGuh Crystal Mine&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_bleekwoud.des: Visit the &dPalewood&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_gatenkaasgrot: Visit the &dHoley Cheese Caves&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_kaasmoeras.de: Visit the &dCheese Swamp&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_vadswoud.desc: Visit the &dChonkwood Forest&r biome in the Guhmension.
Visit the &dDeep Guh Sea&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_knuffeldal.de: Visit the &dSnuggledale&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guhpolder.des: Visit the &dGuh Polder&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_sneeuwguhtoen: Visit the &dSnowguh Tundra&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guhwaii.title: Guhwai'i
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.biome_guhwaii.desc: Visit the &dGuhwai'i&r biome in the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bee.title: Buzz Buzz Guh
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bee.desc: Find a &dGuh Bee&r (Guhmension or a flowery Overworld). They never get angry!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.korf.title: Nibble Hive
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.korf.desc: Craft a Nibble Hive. Is it full? Shears = cheese nibbles, glass bottle = Cheese Honey.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.slime.title: Wobbleguh
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.slime.desc: Find a pink &dGuh Slime&r. They don't hurt anybody.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.slimeblock.title: Sticky Chonk
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.slimeblock.desc: Nine guh slimeballs make a pink guh slime block: bouncy and sticky.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.fish.title: Guhfish
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.fish.desc: Catch a Guhfish in the Guh Sea (bucket or fishing rod) and cook it.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.mika.title: NYEG!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.mika.desc: Run into a &cMika&r: the grumpy guh. It shoves you away, but it doesn't hurt.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.mepper.title: Mika Whacker
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.mepper.desc: Buy the Mika Whacker from the Mika Hunter: five times as strong against Mikas, and it never breaks.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.big_mika.title: The Bigger the Mika...
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.big_mika.desc: Defeat &cBig Mika&r in a challenging guh cave.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.nether_mika.title: Hot Mika
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.nether_mika.desc: Find a &cNether Mika&r in the Nether: totally fireproof.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.kasteel.title: Long Live the King!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.kasteel.desc: The legendary &dGuh Castle&r: 256x256, with a guh head on the tower. The &5Guhmension Super Compass&r (pick: Wonders > Guh Castle) shows the way; it can be really far!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.koning_tem.title: Your Wahoog Majesty
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.koning_tem.desc: Tame the King Guh on his throne with cheese nibbles and get his royal outfit (crown, cape, medallion). After one day a new king shows up, so everyone can tame one!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.kasteel_schat.title: The Treasure Room
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.kasteel_schat.desc: Find the treasure room behind the throne (through the gallery) and take the &6Royal Guh Throne&r home with you.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.guhvriend.title: Guh Friend
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.guhvriend.desc: The gatekeepers of the Guh Castle only let guh friends in. Prove it: have a nice chonky sit on the bench, or say the secret guh word in chat...
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.sleehut.title: The Sled Hut
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.sleehut.desc: On the Guh Peaks there's a snowy little hut with Guh Blossom trees. The Sled Guh is sad...
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.sled.title: The Broken Sled
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.sled.desc: Bring the Sled Guh a Sled Runner (guh caves), a guh bell (guh villages) and a pink ribbon (tailor).
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.ride_sled.title: WHEEE!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.ride_sled.desc: Build a track and ride your Guh Sled (four guhs pull it!).
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.coaster.title: Your Own Roller Coaster
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.coaster.desc: Craft a Chonk Drop, a Guh Corkscrew and a Wahoog Ramp (Sled Builder's Book) and build your very own roller coaster.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.knabbelboer.title: Nibble Farmer
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.knabbelboer.desc: Place a Chonk Seed Box in a guh village and plant Cheese Nibble Seeds on farmland.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bloesem.title: Guh Blossom
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bloesem.desc: Find a Guh Blossom tree and grab a sapling.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.ze_hangen.title: They Hang On My Chonk
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.ze_hangen.desc: At the Guh Picnic a jukebox is playing a guh record. Take it with you (right-click the jukebox)!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.crystal.title: Guh Crystal
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.crystal.desc: Dig around the Guhmension for a crystal mine (y30-60).
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.spyglass.title: Guh Crystal Spyglass
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.spyglass.desc: Makes rare guhs light up, even through walls.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.vads.title: Super Wahoog!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.vads.desc: Mine Compressed Super Wahoog Chonk (iron pickaxe) and smelt it.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.paxel.title: Chonk Paxel
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.paxel.desc: Pickaxe, axe and shovel in one, and it never breaks.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.schaar.title: Chonk Shears
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.schaar.desc: Two Wahoog Chonk diagonally above each other, just like ordinary shears. They cut everything shears cut, and they never break.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank.title: The Hungry Guh
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank.desc: At a &dguh picnic&r in the Guhmension sits the &dHungry Guh&r. Feed him 10 &efried cheese nibbles&r (from the Guh Frying Pan with Mika's Grease) and you get his buddy the &dBank Guh&r. Every player gets one, and this is the only way to get a Bank Guh: you can't craft it. So take good care of it!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.bank_plaatsen.title: Your Very Own Bank Guh
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.section.hongerige_guh: The Hungry Guh & the Bank Guh
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_eerste.de: Sometimes something happens in the Guhmension, right outside where you are (about once every 2 or 3 days): a &6Cheese Shower&r, the &dChonk Parade&r or, at night, a &bStar Shower&r. You'll see it in chat and on the bar at the top.
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_kaasregen: Cloudy with a Chance of Cheese
Catch 20 cheese nibbles in a Cheese Shower. Just walk into them, but be quicker than the wild guhs!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_goud.desc: Catch a &6Golden Cheese Nibble&r in a Cheese Shower. Give it to a wild guh: instantly tame!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_parade.de: Walk along with the &dChonk Parade&r, behind the Drummer Guh, all the way to the end. Confetti!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_paradepak: Collect the whole parade outfit for your guh: the parade shako, the parade jacket and the little parade drum. You get one per parade, and only at the parade!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_sterrengu: Tame a Star Guh that landed with a falling star. Be quick: after a minute it goes back to the stars!
ftb.guhs_guhmensie.q.evenement_alle.desc: Experience all three events: the Cheese Shower, the Chonk Parade and the Star Shower.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.title: &9Underwater
ftb.guhs_onderwater.sub: Blub blub guh: the Deep Guh Sea
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.intro_guhs_onderwa:
This chapter comes after &6The Super Compass&r in &dThe Guhmension&r (Wonders category).

Somewhere in the Guhmension lies the &9Deep Guh Sea&r, and in the middle of it, on the bottom: &bThe Guh Bubble&r. Walk into the Dive Post through its mouth and take the spiral stairs down.

Don't forget to gulp some bubbles now and then! Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.diepzee_vind.title: The Deep Guh Sea
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.diepzee_vind.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension lies a big, deep pink sea with little sandy beaches: the &9Deep Guh Sea&r. Cheese Coral grows on the bottom, little Guhfish swim around, and sometimes a Merguh. And in the middle of every Deep Guh Sea lies The Guh Bubble!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_find.de: In the middle of every &9Deep Guh Sea&r, on the seabed, lies a giant glass bubble shaped like a guh head: &bThe Guh Bubble&r! Look for the little island with the Dive Post (a guh head wearing diving goggles), walk in through its mouth and take the spiral stairs down. The Super Compass (Wonders) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_parel.d: Right-click an open &dGiant Clam&r: sometimes there's a pearl inside! A closed clam opens up again by itself after a while. Pearls are the Merguh's money.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_lucht.d: Swim outside through a dive door. Almost out of air? Swim to the yellow &6Cheese Coral&r: it blows air bubbles and you can breathe again. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_wrak.de: Just north of the bubble lies a sunken guh ship with a guh head on its bow. In the cabin at the back there's a treasure chest... Nyeg, how exciting!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_duikhel: Buy a diving helmet from the &bMerguh&r: with it you can breathe underwater for as long as you like.
Every once in a while a wild &dMerguh&r swims in the Guh Sea and the Deep Guh Sea: a guh with a fish tail! Tame it with cheese nibbles.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_rit.des: Saddle your Merguh and ride underwater: look where you want to go, jump is up. It swims super fast and gives you air. Blub!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.onderwater_pakje.d: Buy the diving goggles, the snorkel and the swim ring from the Merguh (only she sells them) and put them on your guh. WAHOOG, what a water guh!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_schilly.title: Poopshelly
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_schilly.desc: Off the coast of the Guh Sea swims &2Poopshelly&r, a plushie sea turtle. Find it and tame it with seagrass (or a cheese nibble).
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_poetsbeurt.de: Right-click your Poopshelly (empty hand) and pick &dPolish a Tushie!&r. Then right-click one of your tame guhs: Poopshelly waddles over, crawls into its little tushie and polishes everything clean from the inside! It tickles... pop! After that your guh is &bFresh Inside&r.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_schilly2.desc: On the same coast lives &2Shelly&r too: almost the same, but with a teeny tiny head, and it never scrubs. Find and tame Shelly.
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_bestie.title: Besties
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_bestie.desc: Right-click your tame Shelly, pick &dBestie Moment!&r and then right-click one of your guhs: true besties!
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_beef.title: Beef... Still Besties
ftb.guhs_onderwater.q.piep_beef.desc: Sometimes Shelly and a guh have beef (teeny tiny head!). Just wait: they always make up again. Watch a beef get squashed.
ftb.guhs_maag.title: &cThe Guhbelly
ftb.guhs_maag.sub: NYEG... GULP! Welcome to the tummy
ftb.guhs_maag.q.intro_guhs_maag.title: How Do You Get Here?
ftb.guhs_maag.q.intro_guhs_maag.desc:
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

Look there for the &dChonky Shrine&r (the Shrine Compass shows the way) and help Mother Chonky find her little Guhbert. As a thank-you, she swallows you: GULP!

This is the only chapter with a lock: the belly sizes (64 to 128) really do come one after another. First feast, then grow!
ftb.guhs_maag.q.heiligdom.title: The Chonky Shrine
ftb.guhs_maag.q.heiligdom.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension lives &dMother Chonky&r. The Shrine Compass (Chonk Tamer) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.vadsig_met.title: Mother Chonky
ftb.guhs_maag.q.vadsig_met.desc: Talk to Mother Chonky. Her little Guhbert has been guhnapped by the Mikas!
ftb.guhs_maag.q.guhbert.title: Free Guhbert
ftb.guhs_maag.q.guhbert.desc: Follow the Mika Tracker Compass to the Mika Camp and beat the Mika Boss at rock-paper-scissors. Three times in a row...
ftb.guhs_maag.q.cake.title: The Lost Cake
ftb.guhs_maag.q.cake.desc: Follow the Cake Crumbs to a Guh Picnic and find the cake. Don't forget the 3 Guh Balloons!
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag.title: NYEG... GULP!
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag.desc: The party at Mother Chonky's: she swallows you! Welcome to your very own guhbelly, inside her tummy. Belly Whistle or G to travel.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_64.title: Tummy Aches (64x64)
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_64.desc: Help the Dentist Guh in her mouth: 64 cheese nibbles, 16 Wahoog Chonk Ingots and 8 Guh Crystals.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_80.title: That Mika Smell (80x80)
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_80.desc: Defeat a Big Mika and bring 16 Guh Crystals to the dentist.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_96.title: A Golden Visit (96x96)
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_96.desc: Bring a tame Golden Guh along to the dentist, with 32 Guh Crystals.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_112.title: A Soft Belly Wall (112x112)
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_112.desc: 32 guh slimeballs and 8 Cheese Honey make her belly wall nice and soft.
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_128.title: A Garden in Her Tummy (128x128)
ftb.guhs_maag.q.maag_128.desc: 16 Guh Blossom saplings, 48 crystals and a full Guhdex: the biggest belly of all!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.title: &5The Guh End
ftb.guhs_guheinde.sub: Overlord Mika has all the nibbles, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.section.opweg: On the way to the Guh End
This chapter comes after two quests in &dThe Guhmension&r:

- &cThe Bigger the Mika...&r: Mikas (especially Big Mika) cry &5Mika Tears&r. You need those for the Eyes of Chonky.

- &dLong Live the King!&r: the King Guh in the Guh Castle tells you where all the cheese nibbles went.

After that: twelve Eyes of Chonky, the Nibble Cellar and... Overlord Mika. Without nibbles your guh isn't WAHOOG, so go get them back! Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_traan.title: A Mika Cries
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_traan.desc: The Mikas snatch up all the cheese nibbles... but sometimes they cry, too. Defeat Mikas (Big Mika cries the loudest) or beat the Mika Boss three times with CHONK for a &5Mika Tear&r.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_koning.desc: Talk to a wild &dKing Guh&r on his throne in the Guh Castle. He tells you where all the nibbles went. Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_ogen.title: Twelve Eyes of Chonky
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_ogen.desc: Guh Crystal + cheese nibble + Mika Tear = an &6Eye of Chonky&r. You need twelve for the portal (and a few extra to throw, because sometimes they go &5nyeg&r and break).
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_kelder.desc: Throw an Eye of Chonky in the Guhmension and follow it. Does it dive down? Start digging! Or use the Super Compass (End).
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_gered.title: Guh Liberator
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_gered.desc: In the cells of the Nibble Cellar sit gray, skinny guhs. Give them a cheese nibble and they're WAHOOG again right away! Rescue six.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_portaal.des: Put an Eye of Chonky in each of the twelve Nibble Portal Frames in the portal room. Watch out for the Mika Grubs!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_binnen.desc: Jump into the portal. Welcome to the Guh End: an island of cheese rind, high above the nothingness. Where did all those nibbles go?
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_kristal.des: On top of the cheese pillars sit Nibble Crystals full of stolen nibbles: they heal Overlord Mika. Shoot them to bits (or climb up)!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_voeren.desc: Are all the crystals broken? Then the worn-out Enderguh lands on Nibble Mountain. Give it a cheese nibble: WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_winst.title: OVER-CHONKED!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_winst.desc: Defeat Overlord Mika on foot. Watch out: he snatches your nibbles, makes grease puddles and calls Mika helpers. He drops everything when you win!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_enderguh.de: After your first victory you get the freed Enderguh as a mount. Hop on and fly! (Later you get Enderguh Eggs.)
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_ridder.desc: Go back to the King Guh and get knighted. Kneel!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_schat.title: Overlord Mika's Nibble Hoard
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_schat.desc: After the first victory, the nibble hoard under Nibble Mountain opens up. Walk to the south side of the mountain!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_poort.title: Through the Nibble Gate
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_poort.desc: After every victory a Nibble Gate appears around the island. Jump in: it flings you to the outer islands.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_vesting.des: On the outer islands stand Mika Fortresses made of purple Mika Stone, full of Mikas and loot.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_vleugels.de: At half of the fortresses there's a greasy Mika grease ship. The &dGuh Wings&r hang on its bow: off you glide!
Toot Toot, Back to the Middle
All over the outer islands there are &dReturn Gates&r: little gates with a guh head on top. Step in and you float wahoog-ly back to the big island.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_terug.title: One More Round
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.guheinde_terug.desc: Place four Nibble Crystals on the four Nibble Pedestals around the return portal and Overlord Mika comes back. Defeat him again for an Enderguh Egg.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.title: &6The Guhbarbecuether
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.sub: Hot, hotter, nyeg! Help the Grill Guh
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.intro_guhs_barbe:
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

There you'll find broken barbecues: the &6Barbecue Pits&r (Super Compass: Barbecue > Barbecue Pit). The &dGrill Guh&r sits in the big pit: the Mikas swiped his Fire Starter Cubes!

Fix his barbecue, then light a Grill Coal frame yourself and step into the &6Guhbarbecuether&r. That's where the Skewer Keeps are. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_put.title: Who's Been Barbecuing Here?
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_grillkool.de: Let &6Cheese Sauce&r flow over a &8Block of Coal&r: tssss... &8Grill Coal&r! Make a few.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_frame.title: Fixing the Frame
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_frame.desc: Put Grill Coal in the gaps of the Grill Guh's frame (the cracked stones have to come out) and tell him.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_blokjes.desc: Go to a &cMika Camp&r. While you're helping the Grill Guh, every Mika you defeat there drops a Fire Starter Cube. Bring one back!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_aan.title: WAHOOG, It's Burning Again!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_aan.desc: Click the Grill Guh's Grill Coal frame with a Fire Starter Cube. His barbecue is burning again, and you get his secret grill recipe!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_pakje.title: Chef Guh
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_pakje.desc: Buy the Grill Guh Chef's Hat, the Barbecue Apron and the Chef's Neckerchief from the Grill Guh and put them on your guh.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_dex.title: Grill Guh in the Guhdex
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_dex.desc: Stand right next to the Grill Guh: then he goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_dimensie.des: Light a Grill Coal frame (4x5 up to 23x23) in the Guhmension with a Fire Starter Cube and step into the &6Guhbarbecuether&r. One step there is eight steps in the Guhmension!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_biome_houtsk: Visit the &6Charcoal Flats&r biome in the Guhbarbecuether.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_biome_satebo: Visit the &6Satay Grove&r biome in the Guhbarbecuether.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_biome_worste: Visit the &6Sausage Woods&r biome in the Guhbarbecuether.
Visit the &6Ash Vale&r biome in the Guhbarbecuether.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_biome_rookde: Visit the &6Smoke Delta&r biome in the Guhbarbecuether.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_emmer.title: Fry Chonk in a Bucket
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_emmer.desc: Scoop a bucket of &6Cheese Frying Sauce&r out of a sauce sea. Hot!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_gloeikool.de: Mine &6Glowcoal&r off the ceiling of the Barbecuether (with Silk Touch, or collect 4 glowcoal dust).
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_warm.title: Too Hot to Sleep
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_warm.desc: Try going to bed in the Barbecuether. What does your guh say?
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_bouwen.title: Barbecue Builder
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.bbq_bouwen.desc: Make Charcoal Stone bricks, Grill Iron bars and a Smoke Vent: build your own barbecue!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_burcht.title: A Keep Full of Skewers
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_burcht.desc: Deep in the Barbecuether stand &6Skewer Keeps&r: keeps of Charcoal Stone with long bridges. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Skewer Keep) knows where one is.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_vonk.title: Snatched off the Grill
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_vonk.desc: Defeat a &6Spark Mika&r (at its spawner in the Skewer Keep) and grab its &6Grill Skewer&r.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_knekel.title: Skelly Mikas
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_knekel.desc: Defeat 5 &8Skelly Mikas&r. They live in the Skewer Keep and in Ash Vale.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_ketel.title: The Guh Brewing Cauldron
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_ketel.desc: Make a &6Guh Brewing Cauldron&r (iron, Grill Iron bars and a Grill Skewer) and fire it up with grill skewer powder.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_brouwen.title: Guh Alchemist
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_brouwen.desc: Cheese Sauce in the pot, stir in an ingredient (nibbles, glowcoal dust, Swamp Cheese or Mika's Grease, guh slime) and fill 'er up: brew a Guh Potion.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_alle_drankjes: Brew them all: Wahoogness, Smokewalk, Sneaky Nibble and Guh Jump.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_mikakop.title: Getting a Head
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_mikakop.desc: Skelly Mikas very rarely drop a &8Charred Mika Head&r. Collect three.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_baas.title: Well Done!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_baas.desc: Put 4 ash blocks in a T with three Charred Mika Heads on top: &cBurnt Mika&r wakes up! Defeat him for the &6Glowstar&r.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_baken.title: A Beacon of Nibbles
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_baken.desc: Make a &6Nibble Beacon&r (glass, the Glowstar, Grill Coal), put it on a pyramid of &dBlocks of Wahoog Chonk&r (nine chonk ingots per block) and pick a guh effect. Your guhs get it too!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_rookguh.title: Wahoog Home
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_rookguh.desc: A pitiful &7Smoke Guh&r floats around the Smoke Delta. Feed it cheese nibbles (or toss them at it) until it floats wahoog-ly home.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_rookguh_10.de: Rescue 10 Smoke Guhs. Your Guhdex keeps count of how many you've saved.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_paleis.title: Who's Got Our Nibbles?
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_paleis.desc: Find the &cMika Grill Palace&r: a palace of Grill Iron above the Cheese Frying Sauce, full of stolen cheese nibbles.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_ruilen.title: Chonk for Loot
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_ruilen.desc: Wear something made of Wahoog Chonk, and the Nether Mikas leave you alone. Give one of them a Wahoog Chonk Ingot: it tosses you something back!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_asguh.title: Glowing Cheeks
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_asguh.desc: The &7Ash Guh&r lives in Ash Vale: gray and sooty, with glowing cheeks. Fire doesn't bother it. Tame one!
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_dex.title: The Barbecuether in the Guhdex
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_dex.desc: Stand right next to a Smoke Guh, a Spark Mika, a Skelly Mika and an Ash Guh.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_asguh_blij.de: Give an Ash Guh a cheese nibble and watch it glow with happiness.
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_sluip.title: Quiet as a Nibble
ftb.guhs_barbecuether.q.sb_sluip.desc: Drink a Guh Potion. Give Sneaky Nibble a try: then nobody can hear you anymore.
ftb.guhs_extra27.title: &eCaves, Swamp & Woods
ftb.guhs_extra27.sub: Holey cheese, swamp, woods and guh families
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.intro_guhs_extra27.de:
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

Deep under the Guhmension lie the &eHoley Cheese Caves&r. Somewhere else, a yellow mist hangs over the &eCheese Swamp&r, and a mint-green mist fills the &aChonkwood Forest&r, where the guh families live.

Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_grotten.des: Deep under the Guhmension (below y 40), in some places the ground is one big &6holey cheese&r: round hollows, Cheese Stalactites, dripping cheese sauce and Glowing Cheese Moss. Dig down and find the &eHoley Cheese Caves&r!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_mos.title: Glowing Cheese Moss
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_mos.desc: The cheese moss in the caves glows softly. Collect some cheese moss: handy as a little lamp, and for making &dSilent Nibbles&r.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_korrel.desc: Here and there in the holey cheese there's &fCheese Crumb Ore&r: crunchy cheese crystals, just like in aged cheese. Mine a few.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_stil.title: Crunch-Free Nibbling
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_stil.desc: Make a &dSilent Nibble&r (Cheese Crumb + cheese nibbles + cheese moss) and eat it. For a minute and a half you're &7Hushed&r: nobody hears your steps, mining or chewing. Not even the Chonk Warden!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_schacht.des: Somewhere in the holey cheese lies an &eOld Cheese Mineshaft&r, with a minecart full of loot. The Super Compass (Underground) knows the way.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_kelder.desc: Deep in the Holey Cheese Caves, the Mikas hide all their stolen cheese nibbles: the &cSilent Pantry&r. Careful: &eNibble Sensors&r hear you walking, eating and mining, and then &eNibble Shriekers&r yell NYEEEG! &6Sneaking&r is safe.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_boek.title: The Secret of the Pantry
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_boek.desc: In the middle of the pantry stands the Mika storehouse: a giant Mika head full of stolen nibbles. Inside lies the &dPantry Mika's diary&r. Take it with you (for the library too!).
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_vadswaker.d: Three times NYEEEG... and the &cChonk Warden&r crawls out of the cheese: a giant Mika with a sleep mask. It's blind, but it hears you &6chewing&r. Get close once (from a safe distance!) for your Guhdex. Run away or sneak, WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.gatenkaas_vadswaker_v: Dare you? Defeat the Chonk Warden. It's really strong, so this is totally optional. A true guh just sneaks away.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_vind.title: The Cheese Swamp
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_vind.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension a yellow mist hangs over a soggy swamp full of bubbling cheese sauce: the &eCheese Swamp&r. Step in (boots on!).
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_stuiter.de: Step on &6Bubbling Cheese Sauce&r and you bounce up! Sneak to wade through it calmly. Falling in there never hurts.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_vlotje.des: On big swamp pools a &enibble raft&r with a little pink flag sometimes bobs around. Climb aboard and open the barrel!
Stand right next to a &aFrogguh&r for your Guhdex. They come in pink, mint and yellow!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_kaasmot.de: In the evening, &dCheese Moths&r flutter around cheese and lamps, and they snatch cheese nibbles lying on the ground. Find one for your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_motknabbel: A Frogguh snaps up Cheese Moths with its long tongue and then spits out a glowing &eMoth Nibble&r, in its own color.
Have a pink, a mint and a yellow Moth Nibble in your pockets at the same time.
Wild guhs in the Cheese Swamp are often green-and-yellow spotted: the &aCheese Swamp Guh&r! Find one and tame it with cheese nibbles.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_hut.title: A Hut on Legs
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_hut.desc: In the middle of the swamp stands a stilt hut with a giant witch's hat: the head of &5Swamp Witch Mika&r herself! The Super Compass (Adventure) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_onvahoeg.d: Swamp Witch Mika throws &2Chonk-Be-Gone Potions&r. Get hit by one once (it only lasts a little while, nyeg).
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_heks.title: Begone, Witch!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_heks.desc: Defeat Swamp Witch Mika. She nibbles her own Swamp Cheese when she's hurt, so be quick!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_moeraskaas: Collect &eSwamp Cheese&r from Swamp Witch Mika (or from her chest). Great for the Guh Brewing Cauldron!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.kaasmoeras_heks_dex.d: Stand right next to Swamp Witch Mika (dare you?) for her Guhdex page.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_bezoek.title: The Chonkwood Forest
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_bezoek.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension stands a misty, mint-green forest full of &agiant guh trees&r: the &dChonkwood Forest&r. Take a walk through it and look closely at the bark... can you see the little guh faces?
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_dorp.title: High in the Trees
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_dorp.desc: In the Chonkwood Forest, a village of guhs lives in &atreehouses&r, high up in the giant guh trees. Climb the spiral stairs and walk across the rope bridges! The Super Compass (Homes) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_boswachter.d: In the ranger station, high up in the Mother Tree, sits the &2Ranger Guh&r. He knows all about guh families and sells chonkwood, saplings and Guh Nests.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_plukker.desc: Next to the berry garden in the Treehouse Village lives the &6Nibble Picker&r. She trades Nibbleberries for tarts, nests and her picking outfit.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_bessen.title: Picking Nibbleberries
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_bessen.desc: Nibbleberry bushes don't prickle! Right-click a bush with yellow berries to pick them. Collect 32.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_taartje.desc: Three Nibbleberries, sugar and a cheese nibble: bake a &6Nibbleberry Tart&r.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_houtset.desc: Chop down a giant guh tree (or buy wood from the Ranger Guh) and make Chonkwood Planks, a Chonkwood Door and a Chonkwood Fence.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_reuzenboom.t: One Big Guh of a Tree
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_reuzenboom.d: Plant four Chonkwood Saplings in a square and give them some time (or bone meal). Then a real &agiant guh tree&r grows!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_gezin.title: Guh Family
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_gezin.desc: Wild guhs live in little families: one or two parents with baby guhs trotting behind them in a row. Find a guh family and walk along with them.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_baby.title: Small but Chonky
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_baby.desc: Baby guhs are much easier to tame than big guhs. Give a wild baby guh &eNibbleberries&r or cheese nibbles.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_nestje.title: A Guh Nest of Your Own
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_nestje.desc: Make a &6Guh Nest&r (sticks, wool and a cheese nibble) or buy one from the Ranger Guh.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_slapen.title: Good Night, Guh
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_slapen.desc: Put your Guh Nest down near your tame guhs. When night falls, they crawl in to sleep. Zzz... WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_boswachtersp: Buy the &2ranger hat&r and the &2ranger coat&r from the Ranger Guh and put them on your guh.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.vadswoud_plukpakje.de: Trade for the &6picker's cap&r and the &6picking basket&r at the Nibble Picker. With the basket on its back, your guh looks seriously chonky!
ftb.guhs_piep.title: &dSqueak!
ftb.guhs_piep.q.intro_guhs_piep.title: How Do You Get Here?
ftb.guhs_piep.q.intro_guhs_piep.desc:
This chapter comes after &6The Super Compass&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

In the cute guh houses of the Guhmension live teeny tiny &5Squeaksqueak Mice&r, and somewhere there's a cheese rind hill full of &6Angry Cheese Nibbles&r (Super Compass: Adventure). You'll find &2Shelly&r and &2Poopshelly&r in &9Underwater&r!

Squeak squeak! Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_start.title: Squeak Squeak!
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_start.desc: Teeny tiny &5Squeaksqueak Mice&r live in the cute guh houses of the Guhmension. Go to a guh house, find a mousie (listen for the squeaking!) and pet it with an empty hand.
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_temmen.title: A Mousie of Your Own
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_temmen.desc: Give a mousie a &6cheese nibble&r. Sometimes it eats right out of your hand and it's yours. By the way, a mousie also scurries to nibbles lying on the ground!
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_schouder.title: Shoulder Mousie
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_schouder.desc: Sneak and right-click your own mousie (or pick &dPick Up&r in its little menu): you pick it up, name and all. Right-click with it in the air and it sits on your shoulder! Sneak + right-click a block (empty hand) and it hops off.
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_verstoppertje.title: Hide-and-Seek
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_verstoppertje.desc: Sometimes your mousie hides in a flower pot, a basket or a barrel nearby, and squeaks until you find it. Right-click the spot where it's squeaking! Find it &d3 times&r.
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_nest.title: The Cheese Nibble Nest
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_nest.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension stands a cheese rind hill full of holes: the &6Cheese Nibble Nest&r. The Super Compass (Adventure category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_knabbels.title: Angry Nibbles
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_knabbels.desc: Defeat 10 Angry Cheese Nibbles. They're actually just... sadsie.
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_oppernabbel.title: He Was Just Sadsie
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_oppernabbel.desc: Step onto the golden core in the nest, defeat three waves of Angry Cheese Nibbles and then the &cAngry Overnibble&r. Watch out for his stomp: jump!
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_recept.title: The Secret Recipe
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_recept.desc: In the nest's treasure chest lies the recipe for the Pink Guh Cookie. Right-click it to learn it; after that you bake it in the Nibble Oven (sweet dough, disc, pink icing).
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_koek.title: Puppy Eyes
ftb.guhs_piep.q.piep_koek.desc: Eat a &dPink Guh Cookie&r (or put down a little tray: six fit in it!). Whoever eats one makes such sweet puppy eyes that the guhs get hearts from it.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_bezoek.desc: Very rare, somewhere far away in the Guhmension, lies a forest where all the pink has drained away: the &7Palewood&r. White trunks, gray moss, and it is quiet as a mouse: not a single guh lives there. Go and find it!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_hout.title: Pale Guhwood
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_hout.desc: Chop down a pale tree and make &7pale guhwood planks&r, a pale guhwood door and a pale guhwood sign. One sapling grows a little tree, four in a square a thick one.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_oogje.title: Eye Open
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_oogje.desc: By day the &7guh eyeblossoms&r are asleep. At night they open their eyes one by one and turn &6orange&r. Pick one while it is open!
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_kraakguh.de: Some trees have a &6Creaking Guh Heart&r inside. At night it wakes up and calls its &7Creakguh&r: a guh made of wood. It only moves when you are NOT looking. Find one (within 8 blocks) for your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_knuffel.des: The Creakguh is a guh, so it is sweet: all it wants is to hug you. Turn around, wait a moment... &6Creak!&r It makes you slow for a few seconds, nothing more.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_kaashars.de: Give a Creakguh a tap: it doesn't feel a thing, but &6cheese resin&r drips from the trunk around its heart. Scrape it off the tree. Nine make a block, and smelted it becomes a &6cheese resin brick&r.
Smelt cheese resin in a furnace into cheese resin bricks and build &6Cheese Resin Bricks&r with them: warm cheese yellow, with stairs, slabs and little walls.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_hartje.desc: Want to get rid of a Creakguh? Find the tree where the sparkle trail leads and chop out the &6Creaking Guh Heart&r. With Silk Touch you can take the heart with you and put it between two pale guhwood logs at home.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_open_plek.d: In the middle of the Palewood lies a round clearing full of guh eyeblossoms, with an ancient tree. High up in its trunk a little heart is beating... The Super Compass (Adventure) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_hutje.title: The Woodcutter's Hut
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_hutje.desc: Somebody used to live here: the &7Woodcutter Guh&r. His axe is still stuck in the stump. Where did he go? The Super Compass (Adventure) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_extra27.q.bleekwoud_dagboek.des: On the lectern in the hut lies the &dWoodcutter Guh's diary&r. Click the lectern: everybody gets a copy of their own.
One in five hearts is &asoured&r (yellow-green). No Creakguh comes out of those, but a &cCreak Mika&r: it comes to shove you when you're not looking. NYEG! After a few whacks it crawls back into its tree.
